hostname pce
buggy
!
logging buffered debug 10240
logging file debug /rtr/run/logs/freertr.log
logging rotate 655360000 /rtr/run/logs/freertr.old
!
crypto rsakey rsa import $v10$
!
crypto dsakey dsa import $v10$
!
crypto ecdsakey ecdsa import $v10$TUhRQ0FRRUVJQURKcUQzVGlSSDdNNFZYWVM4QjQ2a1pOOS9lTlljOU5aSlFTTTJONVJldW9BY0dCU3VCQkFBS29VUURRZ0FFU1kzSjROT1dWeU82RVBqaGVvekZJSjVGZE9RQUtzRWI0MlZndG9YQnl4NkR3MkJ0bWZSVFdUTEFSVlN1N25rWEZBQUx3ck4wNkhuYXFOTWFQYkx6dXc9PQ==
!
aaa userlist usr
 username rare
 username rare password $v10$cmFyZQ==
 exit
!
scheduler errors
 time 600000
 delay 30000
 command clear errors freerror@nop.hu
 start
 exit
!
prefix-list ALL4
 sequence 10 permit 0.0.0.0/0 ge 0 le 0
 exit
!
prefix-list ALL6
 sequence 10 permit ::/0 ge 0 le 0
 exit
!
vrf definition OOB
 exit
!
router ospf4 1
 vrf OOB
 router-id 172.20.20.10
 traffeng-id 172.20.20.10
 segrout 7999 base 16000
 area 0 enable
 area 0 traffeng
 area 0 segrout
 redistribute connected
 exit
!
interface ethernet1
 vrf forwarding OOB
 ipv4 address 192.168.10.2 255.255.255.252
 mpls enable
 router ospf4 1 enable
 router ospf4 1 area 0
 no shutdown
 no log-link-change
 exit
!
interface ethernet255
 vrf forwarding OOB
 ipv4 address 172.20.20.10 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
 no log-link-change
 exit
!
console0
 no exec authorization
 no login authentication
 exit
!
proxy-profile OOB
 vrf OOB
 exit
!
!
!
!
!
!
!
!
!
!
!
!
!
!
server telnet OOB
 security authentication usr
 security rsakey rsa
 security dsakey dsa
 security ecdsakey ecdsa
 second-port 22
 exec logging
 no exec authorization
 login authentication usr
 login logging
 vrf OOB
 exit
!
server pcep pce1
 explicit
 export-vrf OOB
 interface ethernet1
 vrf OOB
 exit
!
client proxy OOB
client capture-path /rtr/run/pcap/
client name-server 1.1.1.1
client time-server europe.pool.ntp.org
client time-zone CET
!
end
